author: Sofia Alvarez
title: Kehlani - 'Out The Window' Music Video
text:
Kehlani Announces 2026 Album, Drops Nostalgic “Out The Window” Music Video
A new era is on the horizon for Kehlani, who recently revealed plans for an album slated for release in 2026. The proclamation, shared during a charming interview led by her young daughter, coincides with the release of a visually striking music video for her latest single, “Out The Window.”
A Return to R&B Roots
Kehlani unveiled the “Out The Window” video on November 26, offering fans a intentional throwback to the golden age of R&B music. The visual aesthetic is steeped in nostalgia, featuring stylistic choices like bottom-left-aligned credits – a hallmark of classic music videos. A playful nod to a bygone era is also evident in the inclusion of a payphone, prompting a brief clarification for younger audiences unfamiliar with the technology.
Reflecting on Generational Shifts in Love and Relationships
during a conversation with REAL 92.3 LA, Kehlani discussed the inspiration behind “Out The Window,” revealing a desire to recapture a specific emotional energy within the genre. “I think I really missed a certain energy in R&B that wasn’t so jaded,” she explained. She further elaborated on a shift in outlook,acknowledging a past embrace of hyper-individualism and self-reliance.
“For a while,I was in the generation that was really getting into my hyper-individualistic,like,super healing,’I don’t need y’all,F y’all,y’all got messed up.’ That’s that’s how I felt,” Kehlani shared.However,she noted a growing maturity has led to a more nuanced understanding of relationships.”You get to a more mature age and you realize there’s a lot more that goes into these dynamics and relationships. Like, sometimes it isn’t over when you thought it was, and sometimes it isn’t that easy to walk away, and sometimes you do mess up.”
Upcoming Tour Dates
kehlani will be taking her music on the road with a series of performances throughout 2025 and 2026. Here’s a look at the confirmed schedule:
- December 16, 2025 – Los Angeles, CA @ Grammy Museum at LA Live
- December 18, 2025 – Atlanta, GA @ State farm Arena
Why: Kehlani is embarking on a new musical chapter, aiming to recapture a specific emotional resonance within R&B and explore more mature themes in her songwriting.Who: The artist at the center of this news is Kehlani,a prominent figure in contemporary R&B. What: Kehlani announced a 2026 album and released the music video for her single, “Out The Window.” How: The announcement was made during an interview with her daughter and accompanied by a visually nostalgic music video. The tour schedule was also revealed, beginning in December 2025. The story doesn’t have a definitive “end” yet, as the album is still two years away, but the current phase concludes with the release of the single and tour announcement, setting the stage for the upcoming album cycle.
